sloka: ततस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा पुच्छं समन्ततः ।वेष्टितं शणवल्कैश्च जीर्णैः कार्पासजैः पटैः ।। ५.५८.१५० ।।।।
transliteration: tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā pucchaṁ samantataḥ ।veṣṭitaṁ śaṇavalkaiśca jīrṇaiḥ kārpāsajaiḥ paṭaiḥ ।। 5.58.150 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard the king's words, all the demons collected and held my tail, wrapped it with saris of fibres and tattered rags of cotton.
